name: centrifugal_brine_pump_refsim
title: Centrifugal brine pump reference simulation model (RefSim)
summary: Reference simulation of a centrifugal pump on a hydraulic network: dimensionless characteristic curves (cubic psi(phi) and Lambda(phi) polynomials) with brine properties from the ULiège BrineProp library; computes pressure rise, shaft power, efficiency and exhaust state.
language_features: user-library procedure BRINEPROP (implicit library, copied in the file; string arguments, IF ladders)

origin.course: ULiège model bank (Laborelec toolkit lineage), Model data bank, 2008-02-18

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (44 variables); concerns the runnable variant centrifugal_brine_pump_refsim_coolsolve.eescode (the native file is blocked)
verification.notes: 32 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); max relative deviation 6.4e-08 (DELTAP_pump, W_dot_shaft_pump), from the 80-bit to 64-bit rounding of the hand-decoded Brine1/Brine2 coefficient tables. The native file does not parse (CS-GAP-ELSEIF-CHAIN).

related_external: BrineProp library of the ULiège model bank (Brineprop.lib, Brine1.lkt, Brine2.lkt; inventory candidate TM-0479)

history.action: added (roadmap card C-77, T-IMPORT of TM-0487)
